description: Write a KiCad PCB footprint (.kicad_mod) from a datasheet's package mechanical drawing: pad geometry, pitch, thermal tabs and courtyard, using the datasheet's own recommended land pattern when it prints one, otherwise simplified IPC-7351B fillet math. Emitted files are loaded with kicad-cli (sym/fp upgrade) where it is installed, which is a file-format check, not a DRC or ERC. Only bundle_status "completed" (with final_readiness.physical_truth_approved true) means the placement was independently proven against this document; "needs_review" covers everything else that still produced a file, including one built from the KiCad library or JEDEC/IPC-7351B math instead of this document (see footprint_provenance).

documentPath.description: https:// URL to the datasheet PDF. The remote /api/mcp endpoint accepts ONLY https:// URLs (it downloads them); a local filesystem path works solely in local stdio mode (npm run mcp:serve)..

partName.description: Optional part number / MPN to disambiguate package variants.

name: datasheetvend_extract_kicad_footprint

bundle_status.description: completed = both requested files were proven against this document. needs_review = a run finished (or a fallback file was attached) without that proof. cannot_extract = nothing usable. null = the pipeline never reached a stage that could compute this.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (never matched by prose).

native_kicad_valid.description: kicad-cli accepted the file. Tooling acceptance only, not a design-rule or electrical check.

physical_truth_approved.description: The artifact may be presented as physically true. This is the ONLY field that means 'proven correct' — kicad-cli acceptance alone does not.

placement_structurally_valid.description: The emitted pads reconcile with the resolved package's pad map.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (never matched by prose).

syntax_valid.description: The emitted file is well-formed for its type (kicad-cli loaded it).

final_readiness.description: The emit gate's full verdict. null when the pipeline never reached this stage.

footprint_provenance.description: Set only when this file did NOT come from this document's own extraction (a KiCad-library match or JEDEC/IPC-7351B math instead). null means the file was built from this document.

kicad_mod.description: Complete KiCad PCB footprint (.kicad_mod) file content, or null if withheld/not produced.

manufacturer_part_number.description: Resolved by the pipeline's identity resolution — not an echo of the input. See requested.part_name for what was sent.

requested.description: Exactly what the caller sent, kept distinct from the resolved identity above.

required.description: Whether human review is required before fabrication

status.description: The pipeline's own run status. FAILED means nothing usable was produced and the credits for this call are refunded automatically.

symbol_provenance.description: Set only when this file did NOT come from this document's own extraction (a KiCad-library match or JEDEC/IPC-7351B math instead). null means the file was built from this document.

validation.description: kicad-cli file-load result (sym/fp upgrade — a format check, not a DRC).

title: Extract KiCad PCB footprint (.kicad_mod)
